grid.used_fraction: used_rows / rows for one usage_records.task_id bucket
grid.level: 0 when used_fraction is 0; 1 when used_fraction <= 0.25; 2 when <= 0.50; 3 when <= 0.75; 4 otherwise

sparkline.level: min(7, floor(8 * count / max_count)) when max_count > 0; every bucket is the empty glyph when no bucket has a count

layout.order: row-major, oldest filled cell at the top-left, newest at the bottom-right, empty padding on the left
